newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt militants call for jihad to free Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Egypt militants call for jihad to free Jerusalem.

text.p: An Egyptian Moslem militant group on Saturday urged all Moslems to wage jihad (holy war) to free Jerusalem from "the hands of Jews, the killers of prophets".

"Let the Moslem masses move strongly and firmly towards jihad, without fear of nuclear or other weapons," said the Vanguards of Conquest, a revival of the Jihad Group that assassinated President Anwar Sadat in 1981.
"The solution will not be achieved through nationalist and secularist banners, speeches, statements or conferences," the group said in a faxed statement.
The outlawed Moslem Brotherhood, the most influential Moslem group in Egypt, also called on Thursday on Arabs to wage jihad to uproot the Jewish state.

Fifty-four Palestinians have been killed in four days of clashes which erupted on Wednesday after Israel decided to reopen a tunnel near al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest site. Fourteen Israeli soldiers have been killed.
The Vanguards attacked Arab leaders and cursed them for entering into peace negotiations with Israel.
"They are lions in front of us, but rats in the battle of confrontation with the Jews," it added.
"God's curses be upon those who...support them (the Jews)... or make peace with them," the statement said.
